objective: Make the existing public insurance quote-request HTTP application depend on the durable INS-006F/INS-006H idempotency contract while preserving its existing validation, origin, body-size, and stable-failure boundaries.

architecture.fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical normalized logical quote-request records
architecture.bodyContract: Idempotency identity remains transport metadata and is not added to the public JSON body
architecture.pageRoute: No page-route change is required because the route already injects createD1InsuranceQuoteRequestPersistence
